BY THE COURT: By Deputy Clerk
Howard Herships has previously been found to be a vexatious litigant and is
subject to a prefiling order. In his Application for Permission to Appeal, received by this
court on February 17, 2004, Mr. Herships seeks permission to appeal the trial court’s
December 31, 2003 judgment of dismissal in San Francisco County Superior Court Case
No. 405248.
Because the original vexatious litigant order, filed on November 25, 2003, arises
out of the same underlying superior court action, Mr. Herships need not obtain
permission to proceed with the appeal. (See People v. Harrison (2001) 92 Cal.App.4th
780, 785, fn. 6; In re Bittaker (1997) 55 Cal.App.4th 1004, 1008.) Accordingly, the clerk
of this court and the clerk of the superior court are directed to proceed with the
processing of the appeal.
